Palace east, Main Guard south and Parliament south lower wing: original procedural facade artwork by the Helsinki browser-game project (2026), CC0-1.0. Office of the President, Finnish Heritage Agency, Helsinki City Museum and Parliament photographs were appearance references only; their pixels are not reproduced.

Regular and fan-pattern granite paving and tram rail-stripe artwork: original Helsinki browser-game project artwork (2026), CC0-1.0. Google Street View/Maps360 imagery and municipal/operator guidance are reference-only; no reference-image pixels are reproduced.

Palace east, Main Guard south and Parliament south lower-wing facade charts: original project artwork, CC0-1.0. Reference-only photographs: Matti Porre / Office of the President; Finnish Heritage Agency via Finna; Volker von Bonin / Finnish Heritage Agency via Yle; Helsinki City Museum; Lev Karavanov / Mostphotos via Parliament. No reference-photo pixels are shipped.
Characters derived from Snow and Rain © Blender Studio, CC BY 4.0, modified
Snow player: user modification of Snow by Blender Studio, CC BY 4.0; supplied native rig and movement clips
Snow movement generated in the supplied project with NVIDIA Kimodo-SOMA-RP-v1.2, selected, looped and retargeted by the project owner; gameplay poses adapted for Helsinki
Rain officer: supplied Poliisi-uniform adaptation of Rain by Blender Studio, CC BY 4.0; eleven native movement clips retained, gameplay actions and uniform correction by Helsinki project

Lumi GT and patrol: adapted from Ford Mustang Gt 500 With pro Rig FOR FREE! by NoOb StUfFs, CC BY 4.0, https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/ford-mustang-gt-500-with-pro-rig-for-free-f26a29f766844f46910547d6d2cc291d; optimized, rebranded, repainted and rigged for gameplay.

Helsinki Cathedral: Dany Sánchez / MiniWorld3D, optimizations by Jukka Seppänen (kijaidesign), CC BY 4.0 as declared by the project owner; adapted, placed and light-baked for gameplay. Source: https://www.printables.com/model/486571-helsinki-cathedral-finland
Tree models and their textures generated procedurally for the project (tools/blender/build_tree_models.py)
Alexander II monument: improved model supplied by the project owner; calibrated to 10.67 m, placed at Senate Square centre and texture-compressed. Source sculpture limitations retained.
Parliament front: original procedural facade authoring fitted to the City of Helsinki model; architectural references used for proportions only, without embedded reference pixels.
Finlandia Hall facade: bounded restoration using City of Helsinki CC BY 4.0 texture pixels and authored details; architectural photographs and drawings used as visual references only.

Street paving footprints and source material classifications: City of Helsinki public area register, CC BY 4.0. Tram track axes: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Paving and rail artwork are original procedural CC0-1.0 assets; no Google imagery is shipped.

Revontuli: adapted from Bugatti Veyron fully rigged. by NoOb StUfFs, CC BY 4.0, https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/bugatti-veyron-fully-rigged-5ca18dc84d074655966a6fe7165aa157; brand marks and source textures removed, materials, wheels, rigging and cabin poses adapted.
Tram axis data: Copyright OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, modified.

Civilian Snow and Rain: Blender Studio, CC BY 4.0; game derivatives and skin variant by Helsinki Rides; walk adapted from Quaternius Universal Animation Library, CC0-1.0; run, sprint, jump and climb adapted from Snow's supplied NVIDIA Kimodo-SOMA-RP-v1.2 movement and poses
